key_rules: Payment matching requires BOTH amount (±5%) AND date (±90 days) — name-only matching is forbidden
Each row gets only its own specific payment match — never bulk summaries
If no reliable per-row match exists, leave blank rather than attach a wrong payment
Email links must be Gmail format (https://mail.google.com/mail/#all/<thread_id>)
Only include useful feedback in reports — no generic placeholders
Search all 3 email inboxes for every record
